steps.speaker: Eve
steps.content: I'm starting to understand what those lies mean...
In her ward, Eve looks out the window at the Syndican streets and pulls out a notebook borrowed from the clinic.
With colorful crayons, she starts writing something like a fairy tale book...

Chief, today is the fourth day since you left me in the clinic.
Today is also the day of Lily's surgery, and I lied.
The doctor said that if the contaminated parts could be removed, Lily could survive.
I lied to Lily, saying the surgery was simple and not painful at all.
I guess I understand now. Lies are like candy, right?
It's not a cure, but at least it brings us sweetness in times like this.

steps.speaker: Lily
steps.content: Eve, what are you writing?
A little head suddenly leans on Eve's knee, but she doesn't push it away.

steps.speaker: Eve
steps.content: I'm writing my answer to a question.

steps.speaker: Eve
steps.content: I made a promise to the person who asked it. Once he comes back, I must tell him my choice.
steps.female_content: I made a promise to the person who asked it. Once she comes back, I must tell her my choice.

steps.speaker: Eve
steps.content: Whether to stay asleep or to open my eyes.
Lily seems baffled, hugging the repaired doll and looking out the window with Eve. But she quickly gets bored and starts showing off the change on her body.

steps.speaker: Lily
steps.content: Look! I've got a prosthetic just like the nurse!

steps.speaker: Lily
steps.content: The doctors fixed me just like Eve fixed the toys! I'm as good as new!

steps.speaker: Eve
steps.content: Did the contamination removal surgery hurt?

steps.speaker: Lily
steps.content: It did! It hurt so much! But tough as I am... I endured it!

steps.speaker: Lily
steps.content: Look how flexible my arm is. It's all good now!

steps.speaker: Eve
steps.content: Hmm, that's great.

steps.speaker: Lily
steps.content: Will you be able to stand on your legs someday too, Eve?
Eve is taken aback. She hasn't had time to think about this yet.

Still no news from you today.
I wish I could tell you in person. Today, I had a private consultation.
The doctor said that my mental condition has improved a lot. The Mania is stable, and the nerves in my body are recovering and gaining activity.
I can feel it, the stabilizing power from the shackles you planted in my body.

steps.speaker: Nurse
steps.content: Who are you writing to?
The nurse suddenly pats Eve on the shoulder from behind. She quickly closes the notebook.

steps.speaker: Nurse
steps.content: Don't hide it. I know what you're writing. But that person is always busy, will he really read it?
steps.female_content: Don't hide it. I know what you're writing. But that person is always busy, will she really read it?

steps.speaker: Eve
steps.content: Of course!

steps.speaker: Eve
steps.content: He read my stories in the toy house. He will surely read it patiently this time too.
steps.female_content: She read my stories in the toy house. She will surely read it patiently this time too.

steps.speaker: Nurse
steps.content: Alright then! Let's give Chief a surprise in that case...
The nurse hands Eve a report.

steps.speaker: Eve
steps.content: What is this?

steps.speaker: Nurse
steps.content: Your latest assessment report from the doctors.

steps.speaker: Nurse
steps.content: Good news, Eve. You will be able to stand up!

My prosthetics are beginning to respond. Sometimes they twitch unconsciously.
Of course, it will be a long, long time before a full recovery. By that time, you must have returned, right?
It's good news, but somehow I can't cheer up...
I heard that a serious riot broke out in Syndicate and Sinners are everywhere on the streets.
A lot of injured people were sent to the clinic.
I wonder if you're doing alright.

steps.speaker: Lily
steps.content: Those people... are they okay?
Lily timidly hides behind Eve's wheelchair.

steps.speaker: Lily
steps.content: Something must have happened, right? Everyone refuses to tell me. The nurses have been so busy lately. They don't even have time to play with me.
The clinic has never seen such chaos. Stretchers are brought in and out and an unpleasant smell lingers. Nurses and doctors are calling out loudly for support everywhere.
Eve holds Lily's hand and pats it gently, just like Chief once did to comfort her.

steps.speaker: Eve
steps.content: Don't worry. The doctors and nurses in this clinic are all so good at their jobs. They will surely handle this properly. Nothing bad will happen.

steps.speaker: Eve
steps.content: The nurse is very busy now, but I can play with you.

steps.speaker: Eve
steps.content: Shall I tell you a story?

steps.speaker: Lily
steps.content: Is it the story about the toy family? Lily has heard it before.

steps.speaker: Eve
steps.content: Then I'll tell you one you haven't heard. A story about a gray rag doll. But I'm telling it for the first time too, so I'm not very familiar with it.

steps.speaker: Eve
steps.content: Once upon a time, there was a gray rag doll. It was brave, strong, and kind, just like the hero of every story.
steps.female_content: Once upon a time, there was a gray rag doll. It was brave, strong, and kind, just like the heroine of every story.

steps.speaker: Eve
steps.content: That rag doll taught lessons all the time. Many people didn't understand him. Even the rag doll sometimes doubted her own choices.
steps.female_content: That rag doll taught lessons all the time. Many people didn't understand her. Even the rag doll sometimes doubted her own choices.

steps.speaker: Eve
steps.content: But in the eyes of the little white bear, the rag doll who painted a beautiful tomorrow seemed to be glowing brightly...
She hears steady breath near her knees. Lily has already dozed off by Eve's side at some point.

Francisco left us today. I heard he was hit by Mania weapon shrapnel.
He was so close to finishing his portrait for Rhona.
I've seen the painting. It was crooked, like a child's doodle.
But Rhona was laughing so happily in it, like she was still telling jokes to everyone.

Lily has recovered. Her family is coming to get her soon. They're going to hide in a safer place. Chief, you've said I have a tomorrow and the choice to rewrite the lies and to realize the ideals and hopes. I've made my choice. I want to find the ideals you mentioned and to see what lies ahead.
When are you coming to pick me up?
Eve closes her notebook, watching everyone send Francisco off for the last time.
The nurse leans on Eve, somewhat exhausted. She hasn't had a good night's sleep in several days.

steps.speaker: Eve
steps.content: From now on, he will have an endless supply of paintbrushes. The rainbow will be his palette.

steps.speaker: Nurse
steps.content: Pfft... Since when have you started talking like that too?
Eve doesn't answer. She takes off her glove and wipes away the nurse's tears.

steps.speaker: Eve
steps.content: Last night, the connecting end of the prosthetic was hurting a little. Is it healing?

steps.speaker: Nurse
steps.content: Really?! You can feel it!

steps.speaker: Nurse
steps.content: I'll get a doctor to check you out right away!
The nurse jumps up from the floor and runs off, mumbling to herself.

steps.speaker: Nurse
steps.content: That's great. Eve's legs are going to get better...

steps.speaker: Eve
steps.content: Yes, everything will get better.

steps.speaker: Eve
steps.content: The lies will come true one by one...
Eve sits in her wheelchair at the entrance of the clinic. The recently renovated clinic is now shabby again, but no one bothers to fix it now.
The road is empty. The world is gray. Debris glowing with sparks fall from the sky occasionally.

steps.speaker: Eve
steps.content: There are fewer and fewer pedestrians on the street. Something serious seems to have happened in Syndicate. Everyone has probably gone there.

steps.speaker: Eve
steps.content: Are you there too, Chief? Fighting for your ideals, for everyone's tomorrow...
A piece of coarse paper falls at the clinic's entrance. Some bright red text is printed on it.
In just an instant, Eve spots a familiar name on the paper.
Having made sure that no FAC armored vehicles are in sight, Eve carefully approaches the roadside.
She bends down to pick up the paper, but as soon as her hand touches the ground, she can already see the words on the paper...

<color=#dg1f1f>Obituary</color>
<color=#dg1f1f>For our friend, companion, and leader, ${PlayerName}.</color>
